q: What is the carbon footprint of a tube of silicone sealant?
title: Silicone sealant per tube
short: Most of a sealant tube's footprint is the silicone polymer and fillers, made upstream with energy-heavy silicon metal. Mixing and filling at your plant add electricity. Weigh the sealant and the plastic cartridge, then use supplier or named database factors.

ul: Silicone polymer and fillers: largest share.

p: A polymer supplier's figure per kg beats a generic one. Label each factor with its source.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
